lead.event: ADNOC CEO says global energy buffer stocks are depleted
lead.headline: ADNOC CEO says global energy buffers are depleted as oil stocks fall nearly 1 billion barrels
lead.blurb: Sultan Al Jaber said at ADIPEC in the UAE on 2 November that global oil inventories had fallen nearly 1 billion barrels since war-related disruption to shipping through the Strait of Hormuz began. Diesel stocks in several regions are at their lowest in 35 years for this period, while LNG shortages in some markets reach 600 billion cubic feet and logistics costs have risen to 30% of the cost per barrel from about 5%. The IEA has agreed to release more than 20 million barrels of diesel, as Brent trades around US$110 per barrel, roughly 50% above February.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Prajogo Pangestu-affiliated issuers continue share buyback programs
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: Prajogo-linked TPIA, BRPT, BREN and CUAN realize Rp830.7 billion in buybacks
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: By 2 November, the four had used about 18.46% of their combined Rp4.5 trillion maximum budget, leaving more than Rp3 trillion available. Chandra Asri’s program runs until 28 January 2027, while Barito Pacific, Barito Renewables and Petrindo Jaya Kreasi run until 31 December.

market_structure_policy.event: OJK crackdown follows alleged MSCI-related stock manipulation in Indonesia
market_structure_policy.headline: Regulators crack down over alleged MSCI stock manipulation after a 70% share fall
market_structure_policy.blurb: Bloomberg reported that brokerage firms inflated stock prices and trading volumes to qualify for MSCI inclusion. Regulators fined Barito Renewables Energy, Dian Swastika Sentosa, Petrindo Jaya Kreasi and Henan Putihrai Sekuritas, while MSCI removed Barito Renewables, Petrindo and Chandra Asri Pacific from its index.

market_structure_policy.event: Indofood Agri meets Singapore authorities over planned haze law amendments
market_structure_policy.headline: INDF subsidiary meets Singapore authorities over planned haze law amendments
market_structure_policy.blurb: Indofood Agri Resources attended discussions on Singapore’s proposed amendments to its transboundary haze pollution act following forest and land fires in Kalimantan. The process remains ongoing pending further direction from Singapore authorities.

earnings_guidance.event: Fortune Resources Investment reports nine-month revenue and profit growth
earnings_guidance.headline: FITT reports 622% Q3 revenue growth as profit turns to Rp29.41 billion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Mining services contributed Rp41.26 billion, a revenue segment absent a year earlier. Total assets rose 75% to Rp224.75 billion, while hotel and banquet revenue fell to Rp2.70 billion and Rp1.08 billion, respectively.

earnings_guidance.event: Indofood and Indofood CBP report lower Q3 2026 net profit
earnings_guidance.headline: INDF and ICBP report lower Q3 profit, down 0.19% and 13.25%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Indofood's revenue rose 12% to Rp101.49 trillion, while Indofood CBP's sales grew 15% to Rp64.45 trillion. Kiwoom recommends buying INDF at Rp6,800–Rp6,900 and a trading buy on ICBP at Rp6,100. Mirae Asset recommends accumulation, with targets of Rp7,675 for INDF and Rp7,575 for ICBP.

earnings_guidance.event: Semen Indonesia reports Q3 2026 profit growth
earnings_guidance.headline: SMGR reports 363% profit growth in Q3 2026
earnings_guidance.blurb: Semen Indonesia attributed the increase to improved operational efficiency and expanded export activities. The results indicated an operational recovery during the quarter.

earnings_guidance.headline: RMKE reports 9M26 results with net profit up 149.2% to Rp344.4 billion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Revenue rose 118.1% year over year to Rp2.4 trillion, driven by six new mining clients and clearer RKAB policies. Coal hauling reached 2.45 million tons, and operating cash flow was Rp422 billion.

deals_control.event: Bumi Resources delays acquisition of Laman Mining stake
deals_control.headline: BUMI extends deadline for 45% Laman Mining stake acquisition to 31 January 2027
deals_control.blurb: BUMI and Supreme Global Investment extended the deadline from early October 2026, with several acquisition prerequisites still unmet. The US$59.1 million purchase includes a US$20 million down payment, with US$39.1 million due after the conditions are met; BUMI has prepared around Rp333.6 billion for the final transaction.
